# HiddenSpots

> Your personal atlas of nature's hidden gems — springs, waterfalls, and trails.
> Hebrew-first · map-first · private by default · field-ready offline.

## Site

- Home (Hebrew): https://hiddenspots.app/he
- Home (English): https://hiddenspots.app/en
- Sign in: /he/signin · /en/signin
- Sign up: /he/signup · /en/signup
- Privacy: /he/privacy · /en/privacy
- Terms: /he/terms · /en/terms

## Product

HiddenSpots lets people save secret nature spots on a map, organize them into collections and trips, share via expiring links, and use the app offline as a PWA.

Authenticated map and library routes (`/app`, `/locations`, `/collections`, `/trips`, `/visits`, `/settings`, `/import`) are private and should not be crawled.
